Comment_glosser: Historically, 20 in Semitic was formed as 10 with a dual marker and the other decades as 3, 4 etc. with a plural marker (Brockelmann 1916: 119). However, the suffixes have been regularized leading to the synchronically confusing system where 20 vs. other decades seem to be formed with the same suffix but different operations.
Dual expected, but suffix looks more like plural
